verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AgentMail can create many inboxes on demand and list threads across an organization. Those describe scale and scoped retrieval, not a documented batch or bulk endpoint for acting on many messages, threads, labels or inboxes in a single operation. No bulk send, bulk delete, bulk label or batch API is evidenced, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
